purpose: Source-by-source Upper Peninsula visitor-bureau waterfall name crosswalk against 80 curated site records; not an access permit, exhaustive 300+ waterfall inventory, scraped live feed or permission to drive to a GIS feature.

statusDefinitions.curated: Named entry with existing published guide; access may be seasonal or conditional.
statusDefinitions.closure_guide: Published page explicitly documents closure; should not be suggested as a currently available visit.
statusDefinitions.research_only: Regional bureau mentions it but independent safe public arrival/route remains unverified or prohibited; retain as researched name, never a public navigation pin.
statusDefinitions.companion_covered: Different named small tier or alias covered inside an existing primary guide, with no duplicate parking destination.
statusDefinitions.not_distinct_natural_falls: A dam spillway, creek walk without a waterfall, or rapids; not an independently qualified natural waterfall trip.
statusDefinitions.needs_identity_review: Regional name still requires a geographic identity and safe public-route audit.

auditLimitations: Crosswalk records major regional editorial lists rather than every item in every statewide dynamic directory or all 300+ purported U.P. features.
A tourism name or geographic point alone never certifies public walking access, a legal parking area, a currently open attraction, or a safe view.
Regional source listing names were normalized against curated guide identities and research variants; source counts are mentions, not confirmed distinct waterfalls.
Published destination statuses are a snapshot of the November 8, 2026 GitHub main branch; public website deployment is independently verified only after release.
